title: 深層攪拌樁地盤改良~Deep-soil-mixing ground improvement
focus: 攪拌均勻度、膠結反應與複合地盤沉陷~Mixing uniformity, binder reaction and composite-ground settlement
summary: 深層攪拌以機械拌合將膠結材料送入原土，效果由土樣反應性、材料量與攪拌分布共同決定。本課不把轉速或水泥用量當品質保證，而是連結含水比、柱體幾何、重疊、剛度及脆性，配合取樣統計和地盤變形建立材料到整體性能的驗證。~Deep mixing mechanically combines binder with native soil, with results governed by reactivity, dosage and mixing distribution. The course treats neither rotation rate nor cement quantity as a quality guarantee, linking water content, geometry, overlap, stiffness and brittleness to sampling statistics and ground movement from material to system performance.

units.title: 原土含水比的機理與驗證~Native-soil water content mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 原土水分影響膠結材料稀釋、混合阻力與固化後孔隙結構，含水比須以乾土質量作分母。不同土層即使加入相同膠結材量，也可能有不同水膠比及反應性；有機物、鹽分與黏土礦物更會改變強度發展，不能只按深度統一配比。含水比不是飽和度或孔隙比，也不能單獨預測水泥土強度；配比需另計新增漿液水與膠結材料質量。~Native water affects binder dilution, mixing resistance and cured pore structure, with water content defined relative to dry soil mass. Equal binder dosage in different layers can produce different water-binder ratios and reactivity. Organics, salinity and clay minerals further alter strength development, so depth alone cannot justify one universal mixture. Water content is neither saturation nor void ratio and does not predict soil-cement strength alone; added slurry water and binder mass require separate accounting.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設水質量Mw=60 kg、乾土Ms=100 kg，含水比w=Mw/Ms=0.60=60%。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For water mass Mw=60 kg and dry soil mass Ms=100 kg, water content w=Mw/Ms=0.60=60%. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 分層取樣量測含水與乾密度，配合有機質及反應試驗，保留取樣擾動與地下水資訊。室內配比須對應代表性各土層；材料與地工設計者核准樣本範圍後，才能把試驗關係用於現場。~Sample by stratum for water content and dry density, adding organic-content and reactivity tests and retaining disturbance and groundwater information. Laboratory mixtures must represent each relevant layer; materials and geotechnical designers approve sampling coverage before applying correlations to the field.
units.failure: 誤用濕土當分母會低估含水比，配比設計因此可能過稀，造成強度及均勻性不足。含水比不是飽和度或孔隙比，也不能單獨預測水泥土強度；配比需另計新增漿液水與膠結材料質量。~Using wet soil as the denominator understates water content and can produce an overly dilute design with inadequate strength and uniformity. Water content is neither saturation nor void ratio and does not predict soil-cement strength alone; added slurry water and binder mass require separate accounting.
units.misconception: 含水比是水質量除以濕土總質量。~Water content equals water mass divided by total wet-soil mass.
units.practice: 室內配比須對應代表性各土層；材料與地工設計者核准樣本範圍後，才能把試驗關係用於現場。含水比不是飽和度或孔隙比，也不能單獨預測水泥土強度；配比需另計新增漿液水與膠結材料質量。~Laboratory mixtures must represent each relevant layer; materials and geotechnical designers approve sampling coverage before applying correlations to the field. Water content is neither saturation nor void ratio and does not predict soil-cement strength alone; added slurry water and binder mass require separate accounting.

units.title: 膠結材用量的機理與驗證~Binder dosage mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 膠結材通常以每立方公尺原土的乾質量表示，但必須明確說明體積基準與材料留存。投入量只能描述供料，成品強度還受混合均勻、反應時間及土種影響；流量計與密度計誤差可能沿整根柱累積而不易被外觀發現。用量乘體積不包含施工損失，也不代表有效反應比例；本例是材料估算，不能當成適用所有土層的配方。~Binder dosage commonly uses dry mass per cubic metre of native ground, requiring an explicit volume basis and retention assumption. Input describes supply, while strength also depends on uniformity, reaction time and soil type. Flow and density errors can accumulate along a column without producing visible surface evidence. Dosage times volume excludes execution losses and does not establish reacted fraction; this is a material estimate, not a recipe suitable for all soils.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設乾膠結材用量b=150 kg/m³、原土體積V=20 m³，需求質量M=bV=3000 kg。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For dry binder dosage b=150 kg/m³ and native-ground volume V=20 m³, mass M=bV=3000 kg. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 校正供料質量、漿液密度及流量，按深度計算乾膠結材量，核對儲槽與現場紀錄。每柱供料紀錄應與試體及地層編碼連結；材料負責人查明量平衡偏差後，由設計者確認是否需補證。~Calibrate feed mass, slurry density and flow, calculate dry dosage by depth, and reconcile tank and field records. Link each column supply log to samples and strata; after the materials lead investigates imbalance, the designer determines supplementary evidence requirements.
units.failure: 流量計失準或密度變化可使名目用量合格而實際不足，形成局部弱層及承載不連續。用量乘體積不包含施工損失，也不代表有效反應比例；本例是材料估算，不能當成適用所有土層的配方。~Flow-meter drift or density changes can give compliant nominal dosage but inadequate actual binder, producing weak layers and interrupted resistance. Dosage times volume excludes execution losses and does not establish reacted fraction; this is a material estimate, not a recipe suitable for all soils.
units.misconception: 每立方公尺加入相同水泥量就一定有相同強度。~Equal cement dosage per cubic metre guarantees equal strength.
units.practice: 每柱供料紀錄應與試體及地層編碼連結；材料負責人查明量平衡偏差後，由設計者確認是否需補證。用量乘體積不包含施工損失，也不代表有效反應比例；本例是材料估算，不能當成適用所有土層的配方。~Link each column supply log to samples and strata; after the materials lead investigates imbalance, the designer determines supplementary evidence requirements. Dosage times volume excludes execution losses and does not establish reacted fraction; this is a material estimate, not a recipe suitable for all soils.

units.anchor: 每米攪拌轉數~Rotations per metre
units.title: 每米攪拌轉數的機理與驗證~Rotations per metre mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 攪拌葉片在某深度作用的程度與轉速、升降速度及重複行程有關，每米轉數可比較機械暴露量。相同轉數不代表相同能量，扭矩、葉片形狀及土體阻力會改變混合效果；材料供應時序也必須與葉片通過時間同步。每米轉數是運動學指標而非能量或品質標準，不能取代扭矩與取樣；此假設數字也不是現場設備設定建議。~Mixing exposure depends on rotation, vertical speed and repeated passes, and rotations per metre provide one process comparison. Equal counts do not imply equal energy because torque, blade geometry and soil resistance differ. Binder-delivery timing must also correspond to the interval when the blades pass through each layer. Rotations per metre are kinematic rather than an energy or quality criterion and cannot replace torque and sampling; these assumed values are not recommended machine settings.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設轉速n=30 rev/min、升速v=0.5 m/min，每米轉數n/v=60 rev/m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For rotation n=30 rev/min and vertical speed v=0.5 m/min, exposure n/v=60 rev/m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 同步記錄轉速、升降速度、扭矩及供料，按深度查低暴露區，再以芯樣均勻度驗證。記錄應以共同時間及深度基準儲存，製程偏差由施工與地工負責人以試驗結果共同判定。~Synchronize rotation, vertical speed, torque and feed, identify low-exposure zones by depth, and verify them through core uniformity. Store logs on common time and depth references; construction and geotechnical leads judge process deviations jointly against test evidence.
units.failure: 平均每米轉數合格仍可能掩蓋停料或快速穿越夾層，留下未拌合土團與連續弱面。每米轉數是運動學指標而非能量或品質標準，不能取代扭矩與取樣；此假設數字也不是現場設備設定建議。~An acceptable average rotation count can conceal feed interruption or rapid passage through a seam, leaving unmixed clods and weak planes. Rotations per metre are kinematic rather than an energy or quality criterion and cannot replace torque and sampling; these assumed values are not recommended machine settings.
units.misconception: 每米攪拌轉數越高，就一定有同比例的強度增加。~More rotations per metre necessarily increase strength proportionally.
units.practice: 記錄應以共同時間及深度基準儲存，製程偏差由施工與地工負責人以試驗結果共同判定。每米轉數是運動學指標而非能量或品質標準，不能取代扭矩與取樣；此假設數字也不是現場設備設定建議。~Store logs on common time and depth references; construction and geotechnical leads judge process deviations jointly against test evidence. Rotations per metre are kinematic rather than an energy or quality criterion and cannot replace torque and sampling; these assumed values are not recommended machine settings.

units.anchor: 柱體積與連續性~Column volume and continuity
units.title: 柱體積與連續性的機理與驗證~Column volume and continuity mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 名目柱徑與長度可估算改良體積，但葉片磨耗、土團及停料可能使有效截面小於理論值。幾何體積與膠結材用量應相互核對，卻不能互相替代驗證；不同深度的縮頸或斷層通常比整柱平均值更影響承載及止水。圓柱體積假設截面均勻且長度可信，不含重疊扣除或土體膨脹；不能把總方量直接當有效改良方量。~Nominal diameter and length estimate treated volume, but blade wear, soil clods and feed interruption can reduce effective section. Geometry and dosage should reconcile without substituting for each other as evidence. Necking or discontinuity at one depth often matters more to bearing and sealing than the column-wide average. Cylinder volume assumes uniform section and reliable length, excluding overlap deductions and ground expansion; total volume is not automatically effective treated volume.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設圓柱D=0.8 m、L=15 m，V=πD²L/4=7.54 m³。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For a circular column D=0.8 m and L=15 m, V=πD²L/4=7.54 m³. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 核對工具尺寸與磨耗紀錄，配合取芯、揭露或核定連續性檢測，查找深度局部異常。施工設備尺寸變更須更新設計幾何與試驗計畫；地工設計者核准後才能沿用原柱距。~Verify tool dimensions and wear logs, combining cores, exposure or approved continuity investigations to locate depth-specific anomalies. Equipment-size changes update design geometry and testing; the geotechnical designer approves continued use of the original spacing.
units.failure: 工具磨耗未記錄會使柱體較小，柱群咬合與面積比不足，而總注入量仍可能看似正常。圓柱體積假設截面均勻且長度可信，不含重疊扣除或土體膨脹；不能把總方量直接當有效改良方量。~Unrecorded tool wear creates smaller columns and inadequate overlap or area ratio even when total injected quantity appears normal. Cylinder volume assumes uniform section and reliable length, excluding overlap deductions and ground expansion; total volume is not automatically effective treated volume.
units.misconception: 工具名目直徑就是每個深度都已證明的成品直徑。~Nominal tool diameter proves the finished diameter at every depth.
units.practice: 施工設備尺寸變更須更新設計幾何與試驗計畫；地工設計者核准後才能沿用原柱距。圓柱體積假設截面均勻且長度可信，不含重疊扣除或土體膨脹；不能把總方量直接當有效改良方量。~Equipment-size changes update design geometry and testing; the geotechnical designer approves continued use of the original spacing. Cylinder volume assumes uniform section and reliable length, excluding overlap deductions and ground expansion; total volume is not automatically effective treated volume.

units.title: 攪拌柱重疊的機理與驗證~Mixing-column overlap mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 重疊柱列可形成剪力或止水屏障，但新舊柱交界的混合與齡期會影響接面。幾何上交疊不等於材料完全重新拌合，偏斜與工具避讓還可能減少深部交集；施工順序應與固化時間及連續性驗證共同設計。線性咬合只描述等徑平行柱，未含偏斜及材料齡期差；設計需對接面失效模式保留獨立證據。~Overlapping rows form shear or hydraulic barriers, but mixing and age at column interfaces govern continuity. Geometric intersection does not prove complete remixing, and deviation or tool interference can reduce deep overlap. Sequence therefore needs coordination with curing time and interface verification rather than geometry alone. Linear overlap describes equal parallel columns only, omitting deviation and age differences; interface failure mechanisms require independent supporting evidence.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設有效D=0.8 m、中心距s=0.6 m，名目交疊o=D−s=0.20 m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For effective D=0.8 m and spacing s=0.6 m, nominal overlap o=D−s=0.20 m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 將柱位、孔斜與施工時間疊合，優先於交界取樣，確認接面強度及水力連續性。接面試驗位置和施工順序須納入驗收文件；地工設計者對深部最小交集作獨立審查。~Overlay column position, inclination and execution time, prioritizing interface samples to verify mechanical and hydraulic continuity. Include interface-test locations and sequence in acceptance records; the geotechnical designer independently reviews the minimum effective deep intersection and its uncertainty.
units.failure: 交界形成未混合薄帶時，單柱芯樣可全部合格，屏障仍沿接面滑移或漏水。線性咬合只描述等徑平行柱，未含偏斜及材料齡期差；設計需對接面失效模式保留獨立證據。~An unmixed interface seam can permit sliding or leakage even when all individual-column cores pass. Linear overlap describes equal parallel columns only, omitting deviation and age differences; interface failure mechanisms require independent supporting evidence.
units.misconception: 相鄰柱有幾何交疊，就必定像單一整體一樣工作。~Geometrically overlapping columns necessarily act as one monolithic body.
units.practice: 接面試驗位置和施工順序須納入驗收文件；地工設計者對深部最小交集作獨立審查。線性咬合只描述等徑平行柱，未含偏斜及材料齡期差；設計需對接面失效模式保留獨立證據。~Include interface-test locations and sequence in acceptance records; the geotechnical designer independently reviews the minimum effective deep intersection and its uncertainty. Linear overlap describes equal parallel columns only, omitting deviation and age differences; interface failure mechanisms require independent supporting evidence.

units.anchor: 等效地盤模數~Equivalent ground modulus
units.title: 等效地盤模數的機理與驗證~Equivalent ground modulus mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 改良柱與原土在剛性載重層下可能近似等應變，等效模數因此可用面積加權估計。此模型反映剛度而非強度，且原土排水條件及柱體開裂會改變模數；柔性路堤或端部沉陷不相容時不能直接套用。加權模數假設平行受力與共同應變，不適用串聯軟弱層；柱體抗剪、整體穩定與負載轉移層仍需分別檢查。~Under a rigid load-distribution layer, columns and soil may approximately share strain, allowing an area-weighted equivalent modulus. The model concerns stiffness rather than strength, and drainage and column cracking change the moduli. It cannot be transferred directly to flexible embankments or incompatible toe settlement. The weighted modulus assumes parallel loading and common strain, not weak layers in series; column shear, overall stability and load-transfer layers require separate checks.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設面積比a=0.25、柱模數Ec=100 MPa、原土Es=10 MPa，Eeq=aEc+(1−a)Es=32.5 MPa。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For area ratio a=0.25, Ec=100 MPa and Es=10 MPa, Eeq=aEc+(1−a)Es=32.5 MPa. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 量測柱頂與柱間沉陷和壓力，檢查等應變假設，再以相應應力範圍的材料試驗比較。設計書須標明模數應變範圍與排水狀態；試驗不支持等應變時，由設計者改採互制模型。~Measure column-head and intervening-soil settlement and pressure, testing equal strain before comparison with material tests at matching stress levels. State modulus strain range and drainage condition; where tests do not support equal strain, the designer adopts an interaction model.
units.failure: 直接用室內小應變模數預測大荷載沉陷，可能高估剛度，讓實際沉陷及分力超出預期。加權模數假設平行受力與共同應變，不適用串聯軟弱層；柱體抗剪、整體穩定與負載轉移層仍需分別檢查。~Using laboratory small-strain moduli for large-load settlement can overstate stiffness and mispredict movement and force sharing. The weighted modulus assumes parallel loading and common strain, not weak layers in series; column shear, overall stability and load-transfer layers require separate checks.
units.misconception: 面積加權模數越大就表示所有失效模式都更安全。~A larger area-weighted modulus improves safety for every failure mode.
units.practice: 設計書須標明模數應變範圍與排水狀態；試驗不支持等應變時，由設計者改採互制模型。加權模數假設平行受力與共同應變，不適用串聯軟弱層；柱體抗剪、整體穩定與負載轉移層仍需分別檢查。~State modulus strain range and drainage condition; where tests do not support equal strain, the designer adopts an interaction model. The weighted modulus assumes parallel loading and common strain, not weak layers in series; column shear, overall stability and load-transfer layers require separate checks.

units.title: 殘餘強度的機理與驗證~Residual strength mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 固化土可能具有較高峰值強度但峰後脆性明顯，局部裂開後的殘餘能力影響荷載是否能安全轉移。只比較峰值會忽略施工擾動、地震或差異沉陷後的反應，試驗因此需要足夠變形範圍及完整應力應變曲線。殘餘比依試驗型式及應變定義改變，不是通用韌性等級；單軸結果也不能直接代表圍壓下的剪切殘餘強度。~Stabilized soil may have high peak strength yet brittle post-peak behaviour, with residual resistance governing redistribution after cracking. Peak-only comparisons miss responses to disturbance, earthquakes or differential settlement. Testing therefore needs sufficient deformation range and complete stress-strain curves rather than terminating at the first peak. The residual ratio depends on test type and defined strain and is not a universal toughness class; unconfined results do not directly represent confined shear residual strength.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設峰值qu=2 MPa、相應大應變殘餘qr=0.8 MPa，比值qr/qu=0.40。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For peak qu=2 MPa and residual qr=0.8 MPa at a defined large strain, qr/qu=0.40. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 保存峰前峰後曲線、破壞面與試體含水，核對各試驗是否在相同應變及排水條件比較。對需承受大變形的改良體，材料與地工設計者應共同指定殘餘性能試驗及分析假設。~Retain pre- and post-peak curves, failure planes and specimen water content, comparing tests at consistent strain and drainage conditions. For treatment expected to undergo large deformation, materials and geotechnical designers jointly specify residual-performance testing and analysis assumptions.
units.failure: 脆性柱體局部破壞後無法承接預期重分配，鄰柱可能連鎖超載，整體平均強度仍無法描述此問題。殘餘比依試驗型式及應變定義改變，不是通用韌性等級；單軸結果也不能直接代表圍壓下的剪切殘餘強度。~A brittle column may not sustain assumed redistribution after local failure, causing neighbour overload that mean strength does not describe. The residual ratio depends on test type and defined strain and is not a universal toughness class; unconfined results do not directly represent confined shear residual strength.
units.misconception: 固化土峰值強度達標就不必記錄峰後行為。~Compliant stabilized-soil peak strength makes post-peak behaviour irrelevant.
units.practice: 對需承受大變形的改良體，材料與地工設計者應共同指定殘餘性能試驗及分析假設。殘餘比依試驗型式及應變定義改變，不是通用韌性等級；單軸結果也不能直接代表圍壓下的剪切殘餘強度。~For treatment expected to undergo large deformation, materials and geotechnical designers jointly specify residual-performance testing and analysis assumptions. The residual ratio depends on test type and defined strain and is not a universal toughness class; unconfined results do not directly represent confined shear residual strength.

units.title: 強度離散的機理與驗證~Strength scatter mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 深層攪拌品質受地層變化與混合程度影響，平均強度以外的離散性可揭示弱區風險。標準差須與取樣位置及試體數一起看；將不同土層混成一個統計族群，可能把可解釋的地質差異誤當隨機製程雜訊。變異係數不直接提供特徵強度，仍需樣本數、分布及信賴程度；本值僅是合成資料的描述統計。~Deep-mixing quality reflects both strata and mixing, so scatter beyond mean strength reveals weak-zone risk. Standard deviation needs sampling locations and count for interpretation. Pooling distinct strata into one population may misclassify explainable geological differences as random process noise and hide systematic weaknesses. CV does not directly provide characteristic strength; sample count, distribution and confidence are still needed, and this value only describes synthetic data.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設同一族群μ=1.6 MPa、標準差s=0.4 MPa，CV=s/μ=0.25。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For one population with μ=1.6 MPa and standard deviation s=0.4 MPa, CV=s/μ=0.25. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 依土層、柱位及深度分組，將低強度與施工扭矩供料紀錄比對，保留無法取芯的區段。試驗與統計分組方式須事前核定；補測與補強由地工設計者按空間弱區決定，不任意剔除低值。~Group results by stratum, column and depth, compare low strengths with torque and feed logs, and retain uncoreable intervals in the evidence set. Approve testing and statistical grouping in advance; the geotechnical designer selects additional investigation and remedies from spatial weak zones without discarding low values arbitrarily.
units.failure: 弱層資料被其他高值稀釋，可能讓平均合格卻仍存在連續低強度面，影響整體穩定。變異係數不直接提供特徵強度，仍需樣本數、分布及信賴程度；本值僅是合成資料的描述統計。~Strong results can dilute a weak layer statistically, leaving a continuous low-strength plane despite an acceptable overall mean. CV does not directly provide characteristic strength; sample count, distribution and confidence are still needed, and this value only describes synthetic data.
units.misconception: 將不同地層全部平均，可以更準確代表最弱位置。~Averaging all strata gives a more accurate description of the weakest location.
units.practice: 試驗與統計分組方式須事前核定；補測與補強由地工設計者按空間弱區決定，不任意剔除低值。變異係數不直接提供特徵強度，仍需樣本數、分布及信賴程度；本值僅是合成資料的描述統計。~Approve testing and statistical grouping in advance; the geotechnical designer selects additional investigation and remedies from spatial weak zones without discarding low values arbitrarily. CV does not directly provide characteristic strength; sample count, distribution and confidence are still needed, and this value only describes synthetic data.

units.anchor: 漿量與地表隆起~Slurry balance and heave
units.title: 漿量與地表隆起的機理與驗證~Slurry balance and heave mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 注入漿液增加地層內物質，若排出路徑受限，可能造成隆起或孔壓增加。投入與回收體積差不能全當成有益改良量，還需區分原土體積變化及混合膨脹；鄰近管線對短時位移的容忍度可能比成品強度更早控制施工。體積差不等於地表隆起體積，還受地下水排出及土體重排影響；需用獨立測量證據確認變形機制。~Injected slurry adds material to the ground and may cause heave or pore-pressure rise if escape paths are restricted. Input-return imbalance is not entirely beneficial treatment; separate native-soil volume change and mixing expansion. Nearby utilities may be governed by short-term movement before cured strength becomes relevant. Volume imbalance is not surface-heave volume because groundwater expulsion and soil rearrangement also contribute; independent measurements must establish the deformation mechanism.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設注入Vin=5 m³、回收Vout=4.2 m³，體積差ΔV=0.8 m³。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For injected Vin=5 m³ and recovered Vout=4.2 m³, volume imbalance ΔV=0.8 m³. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 同步記錄供回漿、地表水準及孔壓，核對儲槽延遲和材料密度，追查變形與量差是否同時。資產變形與量平衡需共用警戒機制；施工及地工負責人確認材料去向後才核准繼續。~Synchronize feed and returns with surface levels and pore pressure, checking tank delays and density and whether movement coincides with imbalance. Use a shared response mechanism for asset movement and volume balance; construction and geotechnical leads confirm material destination before approving continuation.
units.failure: 把異常少返漿當成高效率，可能錯過堵塞引起的抬升，先損傷周邊資產再發現品質問題。體積差不等於地表隆起體積，還受地下水排出及土體重排影響；需用獨立測量證據確認變形機制。~Interpreting unusually low returns as efficiency can miss blockage-induced heave, damaging neighbouring assets before quality problems are recognized. Volume imbalance is not surface-heave volume because groundwater expulsion and soil rearrangement also contribute; independent measurements must establish the deformation mechanism.
units.misconception: 漿液沒有返出就表示全部留在正確位置且沒有副作用。~No slurry return means all material remains correctly placed without adverse effects.
units.practice: 資產變形與量平衡需共用警戒機制；施工及地工負責人確認材料去向後才核准繼續。體積差不等於地表隆起體積，還受地下水排出及土體重排影響；需用獨立測量證據確認變形機制。~Use a shared response mechanism for asset movement and volume balance; construction and geotechnical leads confirm material destination before approving continuation. Volume imbalance is not surface-heave volume because groundwater expulsion and soil rearrangement also contribute; independent measurements must establish the deformation mechanism.

units.title: 複合層沉陷的機理與驗證~Composite-layer settlement mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 改良地盤的沉陷來自改良層壓縮及其下未處理土層，剛度提高不代表總沉陷必然很小。一維等效模數可初估指定層的壓縮量，但忽略側向變形與時間效應；移交時應確認實測沉陷發生在哪些深度，而非只比較地表總值。此處M明定為相應一維模數，不能無條件以楊氏模數代入；若沿深度應力或剛度變化，應分層積分。~Settlement includes compression of the treated layer and untreated ground below, so higher stiffness does not guarantee small total movement. A one-dimensional equivalent modulus estimates compression of a specified layer but excludes lateral deformation and time effects. Handover should identify settlement by depth rather than compare surface totals alone. Here M is the corresponding constrained modulus and cannot automatically be replaced by Young's modulus; variable stress or stiffness requires layered integration.
units.model: 原創教學假設：假設均勻附加q=100 kPa、層厚H=10 m、相應一維模數M=32500 kPa，s=qH/M=0.0308 m。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: For uniform increment q=100 kPa, thickness H=10 m and corresponding constrained modulus M=32500 kPa, s=qH/M=0.0308 m. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.
units.verify: 使用分層沉陷計與孔壓資料，將改良層和下伏層分開比較，確認模數與應力區間一致。交接須列未處理層及殘餘沉陷假設；地工設計者確認觀測趨勢與後續荷載計畫後才結案。~Use layered settlement and pore-pressure instruments to separate treated and underlying layers, checking that modulus and stress range are consistent. Handover identifies untreated layers and residual-settlement assumptions; the geotechnical designer confirms observed trends and future loading before closeout.
units.failure: 只檢查改良柱壓縮可能漏掉下伏軟層，完成後仍持續沉陷並損傷剛性結構或管線。此處M明定為相應一維模數，不能無條件以楊氏模數代入；若沿深度應力或剛度變化，應分層積分。~Checking column compression alone misses soft ground below, allowing continued settlement that damages rigid structures or utilities. Here M is the corresponding constrained modulus and cannot automatically be replaced by Young's modulus; variable stress or stiffness requires layered integration.
units.misconception: 改良柱很硬就代表整個地盤的長期沉陷可以忽略。~Stiff treated columns make long-term settlement of the entire ground negligible.
units.practice: 交接須列未處理層及殘餘沉陷假設；地工設計者確認觀測趨勢與後續荷載計畫後才結案。此處M明定為相應一維模數，不能無條件以楊氏模數代入；若沿深度應力或剛度變化，應分層積分。~Handover identifies untreated layers and residual-settlement assumptions; the geotechnical designer confirms observed trends and future loading before closeout. Here M is the corresponding constrained modulus and cannot automatically be replaced by Young's modulus; variable stress or stiffness requires layered integration.

example: 原創教學例：原土水質量Mw=60 kg、乾土Ms=100 kg，含水比w=Mw/Ms=60%。若水量增加10%至66 kg而乾土不變，含水比變成66%，增加六個百分點，也就是相對增加10%。此結果不是飽和度，也不能直接推論固化後強度減少多少。配比還需計入新增漿液水、乾膠結材及土體反應性，並以相同養護及試驗方法比較。工程師應把含水比變化帶回材料試驗矩陣，避免用固定水泥量掩蓋不同土層的差異。~Original teaching example: native soil contains Mw=60 kg of water and Ms=100 kg of dry soil, giving w=Mw/Ms=60%. Increasing water mass by 10% to 66 kg while dry mass remains fixed raises water content to 66%, six percentage points or a 10% relative increase. This is not saturation and does not directly predict the resulting strength reduction. Mixture assessment also includes added slurry water, dry binder and soil reactivity under comparable curing and testing. Feed the changed water content into the laboratory matrix rather than assuming a fixed cement dosage neutralizes differences between strata.
history: 深層攪拌以機械拌合將膠結材料送入原土，效果由土樣反應性、材料量與攪拌分布共同決定。本課不把轉速或水泥用量當品質保證，而是連結含水比、柱體幾何、重疊、剛度及脆性，配合取樣統計和地盤變形建立材料到整體性能的驗證。公開資料沿革以指南出版及資料覆核為準，不冒充個別工程施工史。2017年：美國聯邦公路管理局地盤改良頁列入兩冊地盤改良參考手冊；2017年：香港地盤勘察指南二提供二〇一七年更新版本，作為調查證據背景。比較案例僅說明工程用途與界面差異，未核對的工法不作實績聲稱。本課重建公開原理及原創教學算例，不代表任何專案設計文件。~Deep mixing mechanically combines binder with native soil, with results governed by reactivity, dosage and mixing distribution. The course treats neither rotation rate nor cement quantity as a quality guarantee, linking water content, geometry, overlap, stiffness and brittleness to sampling statistics and ground movement from material to system performance. The source chronology records guide publication and evidence review rather than inventing a project construction history. 2017: FHWA lists the two-volume ground-modification reference manual in its improvement guidance; 2017: CEDD provides the 2017 updated Geoguide 2 as an investigation reference. Named comparisons illustrate functions and interfaces without attributing unverified methods. This course reconstructs public principles with original educational calculations, not the design documents of any project.
facts: 合成教學假設：假設水質量Mw=60 kg、乾土Ms=100 kg，含水比w=Mw/Ms=0.60=60%~Synthetic teaching assumptions: For water mass Mw=60 kg and dry soil mass Ms=100 kg, water content w=Mw/Ms=0.60=60%
合成教學假設：假設乾膠結材用量b=150 kg/m³、原土體積V=20 m³，需求質量M=bV=3000 kg~Synthetic teaching assumptions: For dry binder dosage b=150 kg/m³ and native-ground volume V=20 m³, mass M=bV=3000 kg
合成教學假設：假設轉速n=30 rev/min、升速v=0.5 m/min，每米轉數n/v=60 rev/m~Synthetic teaching assumptions: For rotation n=30 rev/min and vertical speed v=0.5 m/min, exposure n/v=60 rev/m
合成教學假設：假設圓柱D=0.8 m、L=15 m，V=πD²L/4=7.54 m³~Synthetic teaching assumptions: For a circular column D=0.8 m and L=15 m, V=πD²L/4=7.54 m³
合成教學假設：假設有效D=0.8 m、中心距s=0.6 m，名目交疊o=D−s=0.20 m~Synthetic teaching assumptions: For effective D=0.8 m and spacing s=0.6 m, nominal overlap o=D−s=0.20 m
合成教學假設：假設面積比a=0.25、柱模數Ec=100 MPa、原土Es=10 MPa，Eeq=aEc+(1−a)Es=32.5 MPa~Synthetic teaching assumptions: For area ratio a=0.25, Ec=100 MPa and Es=10 MPa, Eeq=aEc+(1−a)Es=32.5 MPa
